doc.p: Measurements from plans/README.md on a 2,076,700-entry index (ReleaseFast, app limit 200) identify three main bottlenecks: per-entry path reconstruction on multi-word queries, SearchCache suppressing the seed floor, and discarded trigram floor hints.

ul.li: SearchCache penalty: Query n at limit 200 took 15,286 µs cached versus 226 µs uncached, while footprint jumped from 2.55 MB to 22.95 MB after one cached query.
Scoped one-word ranking bug: Query in:~/devv/zigder e returned 50 of 50 wrong results (6 mismatches reproduced by Plan 002's test) because scoped one-word search dropped the name score.

Multi-word path building: Rebuilding full paths per entry drove a e to 384 ms, test spec ts to 226 ms, and src main to 92 ms; directory memoization cut them to 36 ms, 24 ms, and 11.7 ms with zero oracle mismatches.

doc.h2: Engine Worker State Machine & Open Hazards
doc.p: zig/STATE_MACHINES.md documents 13 state machines and 7 resolved issue clusters backed by 20 regression tests in zig/tests_state.zig (all 27 suite tests passing on 2026-11-24). The diagram below models the background index-worker lifecycle on Engine in zig/engine.zig (loading or scanning the filesystem index, swapping Live, starting FSEvents, and draining on shutdown):
doc.mermaid: stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> Idle Idle --> Building: startAsync Building --> Ready: index attached Building --> Idle: no index and no scan root Ready --> Building: rescan requested Building --> Building: rescan requested while a build runs Ready --> Stopped: stop Building --> Stopped: stop (waits for the build) Idle --> Stopped: stop

td.p: Before startAsync runs, or when index load fails and scan_root is null.
workerMain loads zidx_path, converts founder_path, or runs walk.scan; rescan_wanted loops another pass if requested mid-build.
attachLive swaps in the new Live snapshot, starts fsevents.watch, increments generation, and wakes the UI.
stop() clears waker_win, drains and destroys the FSEvents stream, joins worker threads, and deinit() frees live.
Reload and sort follow entries by name or id (app_sel.zig); rename stores name; delete dialog owns targets; modal overlays block background shortcuts.
Exclusive rename (RENAME_EXCL), existence check before copy fallback, non-recursive undo of creations, toast on failure.
navigateTo owns its path copy; history updates only on open; closeTab shifts active index; missing folder falls back to parent.
4. Index never recovers from lost events
applyEvents triggers rescan; worker swaps index and restarts stream; SearchCache keys on Live epoch.
Stream.destroy drains serial queue; on_close clears window pointers; thread handles change under lock.
Dead slots stay in overlay_map and are revived for repeated paths (see open hazard H4 for temporary names).
walk.scan has no cancel flag; quit during first scan waits until scan ends.
Engine.mutex is held during disk I/O (loadFolder, addSubtree), risking UI stalls.
Every dropped-event flag triggers a full scan instead of replaying the gap up to 3 times.
Live overlay never compacts back to the index file on disk.
Quick Look keeps initial targets while visible (QuickLook.updateIfVisible unused).
Native menu and handleShortcuts bind the same keys, risking double-fired actions.

doc.p: Plans in plans/README.md run in dependency order. Plan 001 is already resolved at c78fdf0; Plans 004 and 005 both modify zig/search_bitmap.zig and must execute sequentially.

step.title: Restore clean-cache build targets (Plan 001)
step.p: Resolved independently at c78fdf0: build.zig configures lines and bench from a clean cache.

step.title: Add large-index oracle test and fix scoped name score (Plan 002)
step.p: Add a correctness oracle reaching above 60,000 matches and restore name scoring for scoped one-word queries (depends on 001).

step.title: Align bench harness with app search (Plan 003)
step.p: Update zig/bench.zig to model limit 200 and multi-word queries matching zig/app.zig (depends on 001).

step.title: Remove SearchCache from inline search (Plan 004)
step.p: Drop cached full-list collection on inline queries, removing the 20 MB footprint jump and 15 ms cached keystroke spike (depends on 002, 003).

step.title: Memoize folder scoring in multi-word search (Plan 005)
step.p: Cache directory scores per folder in zig/search_bitmap.zig rather than rebuilding paths per entry; must run sequentially after Plan 004 (depends on 002, 003).

step.title: Reuse trigram score floor in fuzzy search (Plan 006)
step.p: Pass the trigram pass's floor into one-word fuzzy scoring and extend test coverage so the Step 4 mutation guard fails when disabled (depends on 002, 003, 004).
